locale_rule.page_locale: Exact https://fermatmind.com/en canonical cohort, including /en; current route authority excludes redirect-only Big Five high-*/low-*/emotional-stability aliases, legacy MBTI uppercase alias, query/fragment URLs, and __unknown__ career family.

GLOBAL.note: Independent all-country view; never add as a fourth market.

invariants: US, UK and OTHER are mutually exclusive and exhaust the retained privacy-filtered returned-safe rows.
GLOBAL is recomputed independently from all retained rows and is never added to US+UK+OTHER.
Equality between GLOBAL and the three market groups applies only to this retained returned-safe dataset, not to suppressed or unavailable GSC rows.
branded_query_rule: case-insensitive contains fermatmind, fermat mind, or 费马测试
availability_boundary: Search Analytics returns top rows and does not guarantee every possible row; completed pagination does not prove event-level or full long-tail exhaustiveness.
privacy_boundary: Only M01 privacy-filtered safe rows are consumed. Filtered or unavailable rows are not treated as zero.

outputs.en_query_page_opportunities.csv: selected exact query-page market-device aggregates; clicks>0 or impressions>=10 plus top 10 per bucket
